arxiv-2006-01170.title: Emergent gravity from patterns in natural numbers
arxiv-2006-01170.creator: Atreya Chatterjee
arxiv-2006-01170.description: Abstract There is natural association of entropy with gravitational systems on one hand and partition of natural numbers on the other hand. We show that given a partition of natural numbers, it is possible to directly associate a metric with it. Gravity emerges from patterns in partition.

arxiv-2110-14392.title: TaylorSwiftNet: Taylor Driven Temporal Modeling for Swift Future Frame Prediction
arxiv-2110-14392.creator: Saber Pourheydari*, Emad Bahrami*, Mohsen Fayyaz*, Gianpiero Francesca, Mehdi Noroozi † \dagger, Juergen Gall
arxiv-2110-14392.description: Abstract While recurrent neural networks (RNNs) demonstrate outstanding capabilities for future video frame prediction, they model dynamics in a discrete time space, i.e., they predict the frames sequentially with a fixed temporal step. RNNs are therefore prone to accumulate the error as the number of future frames increases.

arxiv-2203-10456.title: simCrossTrans: A Simple Cross -Modality Trans fer Learning for Object Detection with C onvNets or Vision T ransformers
arxiv-2203-10456.creator: Xiaoke Shen, Ioannis Stamos
arxiv-2203-10456.description: Abstract Transfer learning is widely used in computer vision (CV), natural language processing (NLP) and achieves great success. Most transfer learning systems are based on the same modality (e.g. RGB image in CV and text in NLP). However, the cross-modality transfer learning (CMTL) systems are scarce.

arxiv-2208-12040.title: The modified scattering for Dirac equations of scattering-critical nonlinearity Thanks: 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification. 35Q41, 35Q40, 35Q55. Thanks: Keywords and phrases. Maxwell-Dirac equations, Lorenz gauge, global well-posedness, modified scattering, energy estimates, phase modification.
arxiv-2208-12040.creator: Yonggeun Cho, Soonsik Kwon, Kiyeon Lee, Changhun Yang
arxiv-2208-12040.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Yonggeun Cho, Soonsik Kwon, Kiyeon Lee, Changhun Yang. In this paper, we consider the Maxwell-Dirac system in 3 dimension under zero magnetic field. We prove the global well-posedness and modified scattering for small solutions in the weighted Sobolev class. Imposing the Lorenz gauge condition, (and taking the Dirac projection operator), it becomes a system of Dirac equations with Hartree type nonlinearity with a long range potential as | x | − 1 |x|^{-1} . We perform the weighted energy estimates.

arxiv-2310-20339.title: ExoRecovery: Push Recovery with a Lower-Limb Exoskeleton based on Stepping Strategy
arxiv-2310-20339.creator: Zeynep Özge Orhan, Milad Shafiee, Vincent Juillard, Joel Coelho Oliveira, Auke Ijspeert, Mohamed Bouri
arxiv-2310-20339.description: Abstract Balance loss is a significant challenge in lower-limb exoskeleton applications, as it can lead to potential falls, thereby impacting user safety and confidence. We introduce a control framework for omnidirectional recovery step planning by online optimization of step duration and position in response to external forces.

arxiv-2401-12667.title: Feature Selection via Robust Weighted Score for High Dimensional Binary Class-Imbalanced Gene Expression Data
arxiv-2401-12667.creator: Zardad Khan, Amjad Ali, Saeed Aldahmani
arxiv-2401-12667.description: Abstract In this paper, a robust weighted score for unbalanced data (ROWSU) is proposed for selecting the most discriminative feature for high dimensional gene expression binary classification with class-imbalance problem. The method addresses one of the most challenging problems of highly skewed class distributions in gene expression datasets that adversely affect the performance of classification algorithms.

arxiv-2403-07555.title: Steady Granular Flow in a Rotating Drum: Universal description of stress, velocity and packing fraction profiles covering grain shape effects from convex to very concave.
arxiv-2403-07555.creator: Weiyi Wang 1, Jonathan Barés 1, Mathieu Renouf 1, Emilien Azéma 1,2,
arxiv-2403-07555.description: Abstract The flow behavior of granular matter is significantly influenced by the shape of constituent particles. This effect is particularly pronounced for very concave particles, which exhibit unique flow characteristics such as higher porosity and sharper phase transitions between jamming and unjamming states.

arxiv-2508-03085.title: When AI Evaluates Its Own Work: Validating Learner-Initiated, AI-Generated Physics Practice Problems
arxiv-2508-03085.creator: Tobias Geisler, Gerd Kortemeyer
arxiv-2508-03085.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) can now generate physics practice problems in real time, yet the educational value of these items hinges on rapid, reliable post-generation vetting. We investigated which automated checks are both technically feasible and pedagogically meaningful when exercises are produced on demand within a chatbot interface.

arxiv-2509-21725.title: Information-Theoretic Bayesian Optimization for Bilevel Optimization Problems
arxiv-2509-21725.creator: Takuya Kanayama, Yuki Ito, Tomoyuki Tamura, Masayuki Karasuyama
arxiv-2509-21725.description: Abstract A bilevel optimization problem consists of two optimization problems nested as an upper- and a lower-level problem, in which the optimality of the lower-level problem defines a constraint for the upper-level problem. This paper considers Bayesian optimization (BO) for the case that both the upper- and lower-levels involve expensive black-box functions.

pmc-10537141.title: Gestational diabetes mellitus, follow-up of future maternal risk of cardiovascular disease and the use of eHealth technologies—a scoping review
pmc-10537141.creator: Bendik S. Fiskå, Aase Serine Devold Pay, Anne Cathrine Staff, Meryam Sugulle
pmc-10537141.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundGlobally, gestational diabetes mellitus complicates 1 in 6 pregnancies and increases future risk of type 2 diabetes and cardiovascular disease in the affected women. There is a lack of consensus on the optimal follow-up of these women. eHealth is emerging as a health care tool, but its practical utility and advantages over standard care in the follow-up after pregnancy complications remains to be determined.

pmc-12535512.title: Intra-arterial Injection of OTR4132, a Novel Neuroprotector in Acute Ischemic Stroke: The MaTRISS Trial
pmc-12535512.creator: Xavier Barreau, René Anxionnat, Olivier Heck, Igor Sibon, Charlotte Rosso, Catherine Oppenheim, Francisco Moniche, Frédéric Sedel, Franck Chiappini, Agnès Choppin, Martin Inizan, Denis Barritault, Olivier Detante
pmc-12535512.description: Background and ObjectivesThere is an important need for the development of neuroprotective therapeutic agents that could be combined to reperfusion strategies in acute ischemic stroke to improve patient prognosis. OTR4132 is a polymer of glucose engineered to mimic heparan sulfates (HS), which demonstrated neuroprotective effects in animal models.

pmc-12550900.title: Limited Prognostic Value of Psoas Muscle Indices in Patients Undergoing Revascularization for Chronic Limb-Threatening Ischemia
pmc-12550900.creator: Joanna Halman, Jakub Dybcio, Kamil Myszczyński, Nina Kimilu, Agnieszka Blacha, Grzegorz Owedyk, Jacek Wojciechowski, Mariusz Siemiński, Gaetano Santulli
pmc-12550900.description: Background: Sarcopenia is linked with high rates of adverse surgical outcomes, and computed tomography angiography (CTA)-based psoas measurements are used as imaging sarcopenia surrogates. Their prognostic value in patients with chronic limb-threatening ischemia (CLTI) undergoing revascularization remains uncertain. Objectives: To evaluate whether CTA-derived psoas muscle indices predict complications and mortality after lower-limb revascularization for CLTI.

pmc-12619483.title: Quantitative analysis of chest computed tomography in alpha-1-antitrypsin deficiency
pmc-12619483.creator: Philipp Höger, Johanna Benholz, Oliver Weinheimer, Mark Oliver Wielpütz, Claus Peter Heußel, Arved Bischoff, Ralf Eberhardt, Katharina Buschulte, Sebastian Fähndrich, Julia D. Michels-Zetsche, Hilal Ersöz, Arturo Olivares Rivera, Felix Herth, Franziska C. Trudzinski
pmc-12619483.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundChest quantitative computed tomography (QCT) has been used in clinical trials to monitor patients with alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency (AATD). There is limited data on the use of quantitative computed tomography (QCT) to phenotype emphysema in AATD.MethodsData from patients with a reduced AATD serum level and/or at least one deficiency mutation, who underwent a chest CT scan at the Thoraxklinik, University of Heidelberg, between 03/2012 and 02/2024, were retrospectively analyzed.

pmc-13212630.title: Long-term patient satisfaction and complication rates after orthognathic surgery: a minimum 3-year follow-up study
pmc-13212630.creator: Șerban Talpoș, Dan Loloș, Tareq Hajaj, Robert Avramut, Camelia Szuhanek, Bogdan Antonio Loloș, Andreea Raissa Hojda, Sorin Gheorghe Mihali, Daniel Raul Chioibaș, Mălina Popa
pmc-13212630.description: Background and objectivesOrthognathic surgery aims to correct dentofacial deformities and improve both function and facial esthetics. This study assessed long-term patient satisfaction and complication rates following bimaxillary orthognathic surgery, using a customized questionnaire to evaluate esthetic, functional, and psychosocial outcomes.

pmc-13332622.description: Corresponding Author In this issue of JACC: Case Reports, Zourane et al1 showcases a significant advancement in structural heart interventions by detailing the first use of transcatheter electrosurgery to perforate a neoskirt created after a transcatheter aortic valve–in–transcatheter aortic valve (TAV-in-TAV) procedure.
